lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate (1) to long flange A (3), ~90 deg. Perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the convex outer arc apex, with the nearest scan point 0.20-0.22 mm away. The line spans the full fold zone, about 0-40 mm, ending at the plate notch. The hole boss in flange A sits above the fold and does not interrupt it.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Plate (1) to end flange C (6), ~90 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer apex, with the nearest point 0.06-0.23 mm away. The line runs the full width of flange C, about 25.7 mm, from the plate edge to the relief notch.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Plate (2) to back-folded flange B (5), ~126-129 deg bend with an included angle of ~51 deg; both legs measured by eye in the section. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer convex apex, with the nearest point 0.16-0.20 mm away. The large apex_offset of 3.6 mm is measured from the virtual sharp corner and is expected at this angle; it is not an error. The line covers the whole fold, about 0-34.6 mm, from the corner notch to the end relief.
